## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation 1: mixed sector leadership with Healthcare/Energy/Communication up while Technology/Industrials/Financials lag; Confirmation 2: Top 5 performers span 4 sectors (Leadership: Broad, 4 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Healthcare leads: MRK (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +20.54%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +8.63% | 1M: +13.29%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +7.34% | 1M: +15.21%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: PSX (1W: +7.98% | 1M: +16.66%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +9.31%) ABOVE TREND. Communication showing strength: NFLX (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +16.82%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Technology lagging overall: AVGO (1W: -12.88% | 1M: -6.21%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -10.76% | 1M: -1.45%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -8.07% | 1M: -12.00%) BELOW TREND. Industrials weak: DE (1W: -6.32% | 1M: -1.06%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -4.61% | 1M: -8.29%) BELOW TREND. Financials soft: JPM (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +3.48%) CORRECTION, breadth showing internal rotation.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: MRK (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +20.54%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +11.78% | 1M: +18.99%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +8.63% | 1M: +13.29%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +8.29% | 1M: +25.02%) ABOVE TREND, NFLX (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +16.82%) ABOVE TREND; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: AVGO (1W: -12.88% | 1M: -6.21%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -10.76% | 1M: -1.45%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -9.48% | 1M: -12.11%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -8.07% | 1M: -12.00%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -4.61%) BELOW TREND; weakness concentrated in semiconductors/tech hardware.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Biggest 1W movers: MRK (1W: +14.50%), EL (1W: +11.78%), INTU (1W: +8.29%), NFLX (1W: +8.10%), PSX (1W: +7.98%). Note MAJOR divergence among large caps (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, AMZN, ORCL showing 1W ≠ 1M) — this is a MAJOR Divergence; watch for trend break and avoid overinterpreting a single-week move.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed, internal rotation with CORRECTIONs and BELOW TREND names: INTU (1W: +8.29% | 1M: +25.02%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -2.91% | 1M: +4.95%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -1.65% | 1M: +21.76%) CORRECTION, AAPL (1W: +4.82% | 1M: -3.25%) RECOVERY; Technology breadth: ~10/24 positive (Internal Rotation); style: mixed / no clear leadership.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Mixed to soft on the week with select leaders: V (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +6.58%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +3.48%) CORRECTION; Financials breadth: ~8/20 positive (Internal Rotation); news-driven pockets (MET, SCHW) supportive but not broad-based.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Clear sector strength led by MRK (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +20.54%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +7.34% | 1M: +15.21%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +6.92% | 1M: +4.97%) ABOVE TREND while UNH (1W: -4.19% | 1M: -10.94%) is BELOW TREND; Healthcare breadth: ~13/17 positive (Sector Strength).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor exposure to Healthcare and select Energy names showing above-trend strength; reduce exposure to weak semiconductors and hardware names showing BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; monitor the large-cap divergence before adding beta.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: MRK (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +20.54%) ABOVE TREND — strong momentum; CVX (1W: +5.57% | 1M: +8.63%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/analyst focus; GOOGL (1W: +0.34% | 1M: -0.70%) RECOVERY — news-linked catalyst.  
BEARISH: META (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -15.19%) BELOW TREND — headline risk; UNH (1W: -4.19% | 1M: -10.94%) BELOW TREND — regulatory/news scrutiny; AVGO (1W: -12.88% | 1M: -6.21%) BELOW TREND — downside momentum.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Healthcare (breadth strong, 13/17 positive) and Energy (breadth supportive).  
BEARISH: Technology and Industrials (week’s losers and multiple trend-exhaustion names).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch NVDA (1W: -2.91% | 1M: +4.95%) CORRECTION — failure below recent support would increase tech downside risk; AAPL (1W: +4.82% | 1M: -3.25%) RECOVERY — hold short-term bounce; MRK (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +20.54%) ABOVE TREND — continued follow-through would confirm sector leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
GOOGL (+50): Marvell/Google chip deal headline; GOOGL (1W: +0.34% | 1M: -0.70%) RECOVERY — sentiment positive and price modestly confirming.  
CAT (+50): AI/diesel engines beat narrative; CAT (1W: -4.61% | 1M: -8.29%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from price (watch for follow-through).  
CVX (+50): Morgan Stanley call; CVX (1W: +5.57% | 1M: +8.63%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming price strength.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
META (-90): severe headline risk; META (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -15.19%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned (distribution).  
UNH (-50): IRS scrutiny headline; UNH (1W: -4.19% | 1M: -10.94%) BELOW TREND — confirming.  
NUE (-60): Buffett-related selling headline; NUE (1W: -8.49% | 1M: +6.66%) CORRECTION — negative sentiment while 1M still positive, watch for further weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. MRK ABOVE TREND, EL ABOVE TREND and INTU ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is MAJOR divergence among large caps (AAPL/MSFT/NVDA/AMZN/ORCL) and headline pressure on META and UNH — monitor for confirmation.
